name: bigquery-agent-analytics-mod
description: Coding-agent mod that records sessions, turns, model requests and tool calls as BigQuery Agent Analytics agent_events rows, written from the background so no hook waits on BigQuery.

project.title: GCP project
project.description: Project that holds the BigQuery dataset. Empty: BQAA_PROJECT_ID, GCP_PROJECT_ID or GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT.

dataset.title: BigQuery dataset
dataset.description: Dataset for the events table. Empty: BQAA_DATASET or BQ_DATASET.

table.title: BigQuery table
table.description: Events table. Empty: BQAA_TABLE, BQ_TABLE, then agent_events.

location.title: BigQuery location
location.description: Dataset location, shown by /bqaa-status and passed to setup.sh by the setup command the mod offers, which makes the dataset there. Empty: BQAA_LOCATION, then US.

enabled.title: Capture events
enabled.description: Turn capture off without uninstalling. BQAA_TRACE_ENABLED=false also turns it off.

dryRun.title: Dry run
dryRun.description: Write rows as JSONL beside the dead-letter directory (dry-run/) instead of sending them. BQAA_DRY_RUN=true also turns it on.

maxPayloadChars.title: Max payload size (characters)
maxPayloadChars.description: Cap for each JSON payload column (content, attributes); longer payloads are cut and the row marked is_truncated.

flushIntervalMs.title: Flush interval (ms)
flushIntervalMs.description: How often the background writer sends queued rows.

deadLetterDir.title: Dead-letter directory
deadLetterDir.description: Where rows that could not be sent are kept as JSONL. Empty: BQAA_DEAD_LETTER_DIR, then ~/.bqaa-mod/dead-letter.

agentName.title: Agent name
agentName.description: Value of the agent column for main-loop rows. Empty: BQAA_AGENT_NAME, then coding-agent.

accessTokenCommand.title: Access token command
accessTokenCommand.description: Command (no shell) that prints a Google OAuth access token. Empty: BQAA_ACCESS_TOKEN_COMMAND, then gcloud auth application-default print-access-token.

userIdFromCredentials.title: User id from the token's account
userIdFromCredentials.description: Personal data, so off by default. On: user_id is the verified email of the account the access token was issued to (from Google's token information endpoint), instead of BQAA_USER_ID or the login name.

recordHostname.title: Record the host name
recordHostname.description: Personal data, so off by default. On: session_metadata.host_name carries this machine's host name (from the hostname command).
